template:ask:entity_360@v2.description: Entity profile/facts/attributes for named visible entity.

template:ask:what_supports@v1.description: Evidence/source records/citations supporting selected item, brief, or claim.

ui_help.description: How-to or board-capability/local boundary questions answerable as static help.

gap:patch_queue_query_needed.description: Queue counts, lists, filters, comparisons, ranks, city/date summaries.

gap:source_record_360_needed.description: Field-level profile of a named source record itself.

gap:external_context_source_needed.description: Weather, other charging sites, or external data/source context not connected to current board.

refuse:prediction_or_finding.description: Prediction, legal/certified/official finding outside supported claim-boundary answer.

refuse:identity_or_person.description: Person/contact/owner/department identity request not in visible records.

refuse:out_of_scope_entity.description: Unrelated entity/domain/place outside current local board.

ordering_notes: Imperative external actions refuse before help.
Board capability questions are ui_help, not cannot_claim.
Selected item live/blocked/availability/certification questions are cannot_claim, not evidence_gap.
Queue count/list/filter/compare questions collapse to gap:patch_queue_query_needed.
Source support questions use what_supports unless asking for a named source record profile.
